_comment: Unit 5's batch. Same rules as voice_curate.json.
This is the unit with the most forward pointers in the portal: almost every
paragraph of 5.2 and 5.4 ends by naming the unit that returns to it. The fact
stays in every case; the unit number and the 'this is the bridge into' framing
go. One heading ('5.2.4 Challenges — brief here, examined in Unit 8') and one
sentence that lists four figures by name are quoted in full as `find`/`to`.
